newsitem.title: CHINA: France Telecom in China communications pact.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom in China communications pact.

text.p: France Telecom said on Friday it signed two interconnection agreements with China's state-run China Telecom.

The agreements provide interconnections for GSM (general system for mobile communications) and ISDN (integrated service digital network) service, a high speed digital technology that carries voice, data and video.
France Telecom did not give a figure for the value of business to be generated.
China Telecom is the operating arm of the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications.
